description: Defines the Recipe class for handling recipe data, including JSON parsing, bundling, and nested RecipeStep class.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Represents a recipe with title, summary, image, ingredients, and steps; includes JSON parsing and bundling methods.

classes.name: Recipe.RecipeStep
classes.description: Nested class representing a single step in a recipe, with image and text, and methods for bundling/unbundling.

methods.name: Recipe.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Recipe object from a JSON object, parsing title, summary, image, ingredients, and steps.

methods.name: Recipe.toBundle
methods.description: Converts a Recipe object into a Bundle for Android inter-component data transfer.

methods.name: Recipe.fromBundle
methods.description: Creates a Recipe object from a Bundle, reconstructing all fields including steps.

methods.name: RecipeStep.toBundle
methods.description: Converts a RecipeStep into a Bundle.

methods.name: RecipeStep.fromBundle
methods.description: Creates a RecipeStep from a Bundle.
